title: Vercel Agent sessions cost 67% less on average after token-use changes, with billing rates unchanged
detail: Vercel states that Vercel Agent sessions in the dashboard and Slack now cost 67% less on average. The reduction comes from using fewer tokens per session and more prompt-cache reuse, not from a rate change. The entry states that billing rates are unchanged: paid sessions are billed at the model provider's inference rates plus a Vercel Agent fee of $0.25 per million tokens. The change is live and requires no action.
impact: A team already paying for Vercel Agent should see a lower bill per session without changing anything. The 67% figure is an average, so individual sessions may save more or less, and the per-token rates have not moved.
